name: Sugi Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sugi Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates drugstores in Japan. The company also provides self-care support services, including meal delivery, cancer and other health checkups, specific health guidance, health information, and community comprehensive agreements; home-visit dispensing and nursing, prevention programs, shopping assistance, and mobility support services.
